scale: -1 (most unpleasant) .. 0 (neutral) .. +1 (most pleasant); panel values are (mean - 50) / 50 of the Keller 0-100 rating with 50 = neutral
label: crowd guess: panel averages and hand estimates, not a measurement of this formula or of Kenny's taste
source_citation: Keller A, Vosshall LB (2016) Olfactory perception of chemically diverse molecules. BMC Neuroscience. doi:10.1186/s12868-016-0287-2 (CC BY 4.0), via pyrfume-data keller_2016, retrieved 2026-10-09
dose_rule: strength_share <= 0.1 -> weak, >= 0.25 -> strong, linear between; heuristic_unmeasured flips set strong = min(value, -0.4)

calibration.model: panel = a + b * hand, least squares; hand on -1..+1 after raw-scale division
calibration.pooled_rule: one pair per material, using its highest-precedence hand source
calibration.note: pooled fit applied to every hand-derived value; character_heuristic values are excluded from the fit and stored as unknown (raw_value kept) because they do not track the panel
